related_work.campaign_objective: MNCS Environmental Capability Intelligence & Continuous Improvement Campaign
related_work.work_intent_goal: Improve MNCS's ability to observe, interpret, and improve how the environment serves agents working within MNCS.

observation.source_interface: MNCS Environment context and read-only capability inspection

request.operation: understand why a selected-session capability was unavailable using first-use context and exact read-only inspection
request.pre_change_context_capture: observed during this campaign before implementation; no durable session event reference was recorded

outcome.agent_action_required_to_resolve_context: A separate read-only capability inspection was needed to identify the unavailable binding and its resolution issue.
outcome.interpretation: The selected-session first-use context exposed aggregate availability but not the cause of its one unavailable binding. Unknown bindings are a separate state and are not treated as failures.
outcome.scope_limit: This evidence describes one selected Environment session snapshot and does not establish a compiler-wide failure or the cause of the earlier Btrfs incident.

pressure_hypothesis.title: First-use context reports unavailable capability counts without exposing a bounded actionable cause
pressure_hypothesis.subsystem: MNCS Environment selected-session context and capability bindings
pressure_hypothesis.actionable_recommendation: Expose a bounded binding-level availability summary in first-use context with stable resolution identifiers, while keeping unknown bindings distinct and omitting free-text reasons and filesystem paths.

not_measured: The time or number of agent operations spent on this one separate inspection.
Whether the same discoverability gap recurs in other sessions or capability providers.
Whether the unselected compiler checkout was intentional for this session.
Whether exposing this resolution detail reduces agent intervention or changes task outcomes.
